newsitem.title: THAILAND: Kellogg opens new plant in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg opens new plant in Thailand.

text.p: Kellogg (Thailand) Ltd, a subsidiary of U.S-based Kellogg Co, said on Tuesday it would open a new cereals plant in Thailand.

The company said in a statement that the plant in Rayong province would be opened on Wednesday and be the company's first plant in Southeast Asia. It would export more than 70 percent of its output to the region.
The new plant recognises growing demand from Thai families, the statement quoted Arnold Langbo, chairman and chief executive officer of Kellogg Co, as saying.
Michigan-based Kellogg Co is the world's leading breakfast food company. It was established in 1906 and operates 36 plants in 22 countries.
